description.zh: 要加速的上车点地域信息列表。
description.en: A list of regions where access points provide acceleration.
The ID of the acceleration region.

description.zh: 加速地域分配的带宽。单位：Mbps。
description.en: The bandwidth allocated to the acceleration region. Unit: Mbps.

description.zh:
接入全球加速服务的IP地址协议。

> `DUAL_STACK`类型仅标准型按量计费的全球加速实例支持。
description.en:
The IP protocol version used to access the GA instance.

> Only standard pay-as-you-go GA instances support `DUAL_STACK`.

description.zh:
加速地域公网线路类型。

> - 带宽计费方式为**按流量**的全球加速实例需要配置该项。
> - 加速地域不同，支持的加速地域公网线路类型也不同。
description.en:
The line type.

> - This parameter is required for pay-by-data-transfer GA instances.
>
> - The supported line types vary by acceleration region.
The name of the GA instance.

descriptions.zh: 请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解全球加速产品的收费方式和[价格](~~425831~~)。
descriptions.en: Before you call this operation, ensure you fully understand the billing methods and [pricing](t2208086.xdita#) of the GA service.
